svg.title: Straight-line path of 10.3 blocks at 29.1°
svg.desc: The east and north legs of the walk (9 blocks east, 5 blocks north) and the straight-line path from start to destination: 10.3 blocks at θ = 29.1° north of east. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Walker: 9 blocks east, then 5 north. The helicopter and the walker arrive together; only the walker’s
